limitations: Disproves the universal limit-cycle conjecture on explicit codimension-one parameter sheets but does not classify the complementary parameter region. The complete 2025 Advances in Mathematics invariant-curve classification was not inspected; invariant-line classification itself is not claimed as new.
provenance: Exact planar invariant-line and Poincare-index argument applied to the Lu-Zhang modified Van der Pol-Rayleigh system; the counterexample and obstruction surface are derived in RESULT.md.
record_title: Invariant-line obstruction to a Van der Pol–Rayleigh limit-cycle conjecture
